shortDescription: Sweden's gross domestic product grew 1.1% in August from July, preliminary data from the statistics office showed on Friday.

children: Sweden's gross domestic product grew 1.1% in August from July, preliminary data from the statistics office showed on Friday.
Calendar-adjusted GDP was 3.5% higher than in the corresponding month of the preceding year
"The growth was relatively broad based and mainly driven by increased household consumption as well as rising production among goods producing industries," Statistics Sweden said in a statement
Swedish private sector production +0.5% month-on-month in August
Swedish industrial production +5.4% month-on-month in August
Swedish service sector production -0.8% month-on-month in August
Auto industry, wholesale trade provided biggest boost to monthly production figures, transport equipment down
